consequence: Use iCluster2b as the required classical external comparator. Keep iClusterBayes2 only as a same-package fallback if the recommended continuous-data path fails the predeclared smoke test.
official_recommendation: Starting from Bioconductor 3.23, updated functions include iCluster2b, tune.iCluster2b, iClusterPlus2, and iClusterBayes2. The official manual recommends iCluster2b/tune.iCluster2b for continuous multi-omics and iClusterPlus2/iClusterBayes2 for mixed data types.
official_source: Bioconductor iClusterPlus manual/tutorial current for the 2026 release cycle.
paper5_input_type_interpretation: The secondary comparator branch treats the Paper 5 RNA, methylation, and CNV analysis matrices as continuous-valued multi-omics inputs.
